related.title: Amdahl：串行比例與投資上限
related.titleEn: Amdahl: serial fractions and optimization limits
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付弱擴展問題表、每格工作證據與效率曲線；.8333/.625正確，局部工作不變且總量隨P成長；請另一位學徒依交付件重新推導一組；未通過或資料不足必須明記，不以品牌或峰值取代證據。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver weak-scaling problem tables, per-cell work evidence, and efficiency curves. Verify both efficiencies, constant local work, and total work growing with P. Have another learner derive one case from the handover; label failures or missing evidence without substituting brand names or peak rates.
related.difference: 將單核心時間切成串行和平行兩色，註記只縮短平行部分的推導；6.4/9.142857正確，s與P來源明確且沒有宣稱實際速度保證。
related.differenceEn: Split single-core time into serial and parallel parts, then derive the reduction of only the parallel part. Verify both speedups with documented s and P. The ideal model does not guarantee measured speed.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: Eweak=Tbaseline/Tscaled，在每工作者工作相同的條件下；總工作與P同比成長；合成每工作者一百萬格，P1時間10秒，P16為12秒、P64為16秒；名義式 10/12 = 0.833333333333 weak-scaling efficiency；變更式 10/16 = 0.625 weak-scaling efficiency。數據與驗收門檻為原創教學情境，並非所列超級電腦或函式庫的實測規格。
S(P)=1/[s+(1−s)/P]，忽略新增平行成本；s必須是基準時間比例；合成s=.1，P16；改s=.05仍P16，是額外串行優化的情境；名義式 1/(.1+.9/16) = 6.4 ideal speedup；變更式 1/(.05+.95/16) = 9.14285714286 ideal speedup。數據與驗收門檻為原創教學情境，並非所列超級電腦或函式庫的實測規格。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Weak efficiency is baseline time divided by scaled time, with constant work per worker and total work proportional to P. Synthetic one million cells per worker: P = 1 takes 10 seconds, P = 16 takes 12, and P = 64 takes 16. Nominal 10/12 = 0.833333333333 weak-scaling efficiency; changed 10/16 = 0.625 weak-scaling efficiency. Inputs and acceptance thresholds are original teaching scenarios, not measured specifications of the named systems or libraries.

S(P) = 1/[s + (1−s)/P], ignoring newly introduced parallel overhead. The fraction s refers to the serial baseline. Synthetic s = 0.1 with P = 16; compare s = 0.05 at the same P as a separate serial optimization. Nominal 1/(.1+.9/16) = 6.4 ideal speedup; changed 1/(.05+.95/16) = 9.14285714286 ideal speedup. Inputs and acceptance thresholds are original teaching scenarios, not measured specifications of the named systems or libraries.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: MPI 非阻塞集合：重疊進度與等待證據
related.titleEn: MPI nonblocking collectives: overlap and progress evidence
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付弱擴展問題表、每格工作證據與效率曲線；.8333/.625正確，局部工作不變且總量隨P成長；請另一位學徒依交付件重新推導一組；未通過或資料不足必須明記，不以品牌或峰值取代證據。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver weak-scaling problem tables, per-cell work evidence, and efficiency curves. Verify both efficiencies, constant local work, and total work growing with P. Have another learner derive one case from the handover; label failures or missing evidence without substituting brand names or peak rates.
related.difference: 以合成資料重建「MPI 非阻塞集合：重疊進度與等待證據」，能分離架構事實、模型假設與驗收證據。完成：交付三條時間軸、緩衝所有權表與有／無進度的反例。
related.differenceEn: Reconstruct MPI nonblocking collectives: overlap and progress evidence with synthetic data; distinguish architecture facts, model assumptions and acceptance evidence. Complete: Deliver three timelines, buffer-ownership tables and progress/no-progress counterexamples.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: Eweak=Tbaseline/Tscaled，在每工作者工作相同的條件下；總工作與P同比成長；合成每工作者一百萬格，P1時間10秒，P16為12秒、P64為16秒；名義式 10/12 = 0.833333333333 weak-scaling efficiency；變更式 10/16 = 0.625 weak-scaling efficiency。數據與驗收門檻為原創教學情境，並非所列超級電腦或函式庫的實測規格。
畫 12 ms 計算與 8 ms 通訊同時啟動的區段，再加 2 ms 序列成本。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Weak efficiency is baseline time divided by scaled time, with constant work per worker and total work proportional to P. Synthetic one million cells per worker: P = 1 takes 10 seconds, P = 16 takes 12, and P = 64 takes 16. Nominal 10/12 = 0.833333333333 weak-scaling efficiency; changed 10/16 = 0.625 weak-scaling efficiency. Inputs and acceptance thresholds are original teaching scenarios, not measured specifications of the named systems or libraries.
Draw concurrent 12 ms compute and 8 ms communication, then add 2 ms serial overhead.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
